title: Andate là, che siete due bizzarre ragazze!
subtitle: Despina, Fiordiligi and Dorabella: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 1, recitative before No. 19 (the opening of Act 2)
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (coquettizar, forestieri, Per Bacco as two words, Ganimedi; the asides in brackets). Fiordiligi's non ebber la baldanza fin di chieder dei baci ends with a full stop, not a question mark.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 206–210, the recitative that opens Act 2 (85 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 206–208 and 209–210), then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, notes that carry only a German syllable are left out and the Italian note takes their time (bars 3, 7, 13, 17, 23, 25, 35, 58, 79 and 84; in bar 80 the Italian quarter rest is kept). The German singing translation is left out. It ends “segue Nr. 19 Arie”. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 105, from Jacobs (3:14).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
